milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the azure_bluet flower and face it to demonstrate they have visually located it. Target is the closer azure_bluet at spawn-relative (3, 0, 4). Max distance of 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the flower.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate near the white_tulip flower and face it to demonstrate they have visually located it. Target is the white_tulip at spawn-relative (-4, 0, 3). Max distance of 5 blocks with 60° facing tolerance ensures the player is looking at the flower.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted white_carpet ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 4 white_wool and 0 white_carpet, so having ≥1 white_carpet can only result from crafting (2 white wool → 3 white carpet). This is the standard rule for craft tasks.

Uses inventory_has to check for emerald because selling black wool to the shepherd villager yields an emerald. The player starts with 0 emeralds and the only source of emeralds in this scene is the villager trade (2 black wool → 1 emerald). Having ≥1 emerald confirms the trade was completed successfully.
